caption: The drawing depicts three objects: a metal pan, a wooden-handled pickaxe, and a wooden-handled shovel. The pan is round with a muted brownish-gray color and slight shading indicating its concave shape and metallic surface. The pickaxe has a long, straight wooden handle rendered in light brown with visible wood grain, and the metal head is dark brown, curving downwards on one side and up on the other, crossing in front of the pan. The shovel has a similarly colored wooden handle and a broad, worn, brown blade with a curved edge, placed alongside the pickaxe, overlapping the lower right part of the pan. The composition places the objects centrally on a plain, off-white background with no additional elements or context. The artist's name, "ROSE CAMPBELL," is handwritten in small letters below the objects toward the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Tools
